snippet.title: Noyron builds AI-designed turbine #noyron #aiturbine #hypersoniccooling
snippet.description:
Noyron developed a functional hypersonic pre-cooler with fractal geometry using an AI system that independently designs machines. The first version worked immediately, producing an organic, highly complex structure generated through mathematics rather than traditional engineering intuition.

Built by Dubai-based Leap 71, the system uses a closed-loop AI process to design, simulate, manufacture, and learn from test results. That compressed a development cycle that could take months or years into just two weeks.

The breakthrough points to a major shift in engineering: AI is moving beyond optimization into full machine creation. For aerospace and other advanced industries, that means faster iteration, lower R&D friction, and designs humans may never have conceived on their own.

snippet.title: Convincing my wife the 3D printer was worth it (Part 7) #3dprinting #3dprint #diy #shorts #3dprinted
snippet.description:
Welcome back to Part 7 of trying to convince my wife the 3D printer was a justifiable financial decision! The days of crawling on the floor to read the back of the router to guests are officially over.

After my first Comic Sans paper prototype was rejected, we're upgrading to a professional "JakeFi" internet plaque. I taught myself Inkscape, wrangled SVGs in TinkerCAD, and embedded hidden magnets mid-print to create a sleek, custom qr code fridge magnet. This was my first multicolor print, featuring a Wi-Fi login QR code on the front for the guests we like... and a reversible $5 Venmo request QR code on the back for the guests we don't.

Did it win the wife's approval so we can print another day?

#3dprinting #engineering #diy #functionalprint #lifehacks #3dprint #3dprinted

snippet.title: Google I/O 2026 keynote in 35 minutes
snippet.description:
Google just wrapped one of its biggest keynotes of the year Google I/O 2026 and the company is all in on AI. Announcements included a new family of their Gemini 3.5 AI model which will add personalized AI in a whole suite of systems. Starting today, Gemini 3.5 Flash will be the default model for the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search and agent-first coding. Alongside Gemini 3.5, Google is launching Gemini Omni, a new AI generation tool which the company says can “create anything with any input” and Gemini Spark which is a new 24/7 AI agent that can write emails, create study guides and look out for fees. Plus, an updated look at its Project Aura smart glasses. Here’s everything you missed.

snippet.title: Would you let this humanoid robot into your home? 👀 #trendingshorts #tech #ai #robot
snippet.description:
1X Technologies, an OpenAI-backed startup founded in Norway and now based in Palo Alto, has opened a 58,000 square foot factory in Hayward, California, with capacity to build 10,000 NEO humanoid robots annually and plans to scale to 100,000 units by 2027. 

The $20,000 home robot is designed for chores like folding laundry and tidying up, and the company hopes it will eventually assist with elder care.

Unlike most competitors, 1X manufactures motors, batteries, and electronics in-house, a vertical integration strategy aimed at faster iteration and insulation from geopolitical supply chain risks.

The humanoid market is currently dominated by Chinese firms, which accounted for the majority of the roughly 13,000 units shipped worldwide last year, making 1X's US manufacturing push a notable counterweight. 

However, the company is openly acknowledging current limits: humans still perform most factory assembly, and NEO relies on remote human teleoperators to complete complex household tasks, with that data used to train its AI toward eventual full autonomy.

snippet.title: A customer is going viral after sending his PS5 to a repair shop
snippet.description:
A customer is going viral after sending his PS5 to a repair shop, complaining that the device was overheating. The repairer opened it up, only to discover an entire community of cockroaches living inside the play station console. 

Apparently that's what is causing the console to over heat

This customer really needs to clean up their house

One can only imagine the number of cockroaches currently living in that house

The repairer basically cleaned up the device thoroughly, and it was fine again

This PS5 was practically sent for dry cleaning, not repairs
